title: 측정값 기록
contract_types: export type ExpectedProps = { onRecord: (value: number) => void };
requirements: Show a text input named Reading, initially empty, a Record button, a Clear button, an output named Latest initially None, and a ul named History initially empty. A valid reading is a trimmed integer string matching optional minus then one or more decimal digits, whose numeric value is a safe integer. Record with invalid input shows role=alert Invalid reading, leaves history/latest/input unchanged and makes no callback. Clear empties history, sets Latest to None and clears input/error without callback. Initial render, editing and prop updates do not call back. Later prop changes preserve local state.
